name: stemcells-protocol
description: StemCells Protocol — a full-stack stem-cell & regenerative-therapies hospital site to explore, compare and book therapies. Single Node server serves both the API and the built React app.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "node --watch server/src/index.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
